# AiApp.im — AI-Friendliness Rating (full)

> AiApp.im publishes objective AI-friendliness ratings for websites: an open, reproducible 0–100 AFR score and an A–F grade showing how open each site is to AI crawlers and agents. This file is the complete variant of [llms.txt](https://aiapp.im/llms.txt): it lists every published page in both languages, the public API with example responses, and the agent usage policy. Every score is computed from public, reproducible evidence — see the [Method](https://aiapp.im/method) page for the standard.

## Core pages (English)

- [Home](https://aiapp.im/): grade distribution, latest scans, natural leaderboard, and category tiles.
- [Method](https://aiapp.im/method): the AFR standard in full — three layers (Reachability 35, Legibility 40, Actionability 25), every sub-check with its points, grade thresholds, engine versions, recompute guide, neutrality pledge, and data sources.
- [Categories](https://aiapp.im/categories): all 14 categories with site counts.
- [Search](https://aiapp.im/search): keyword search across the directory.
- [Submit](https://aiapp.im/submit): request a scan of a site.
- [About](https://aiapp.im/about): who runs the directory, corrections, and contact.
- [For bots](https://aiapp.im/bot): the endpoints our own scanner fetches and how points are awarded.
- [Badge](https://aiapp.im/badge): how to embed the rating badge on your site.
- [API documentation](https://aiapp.im/docs): public API reference with parameters and example JSON responses.
- [Offline fallback](https://aiapp.im/offline): cached directory view shown when the network is unavailable.

## Core pages (Chinese / zh-CN)

- [中文首页](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/): 等级分布、最新扫描与自然排行榜。
- [评级方法](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/method): AFR 标准全文——三层模型、全部子项与分值、等级阈值、复算指南与中立性承诺。
- [分类](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/categories): 全部 14 个分类及站点数量。
- [搜索](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/search): 目录关键词搜索。
- [提交站点](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/submit): 申请扫描一个网站。
- [关于](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/about): 运营方、纠错通道与联系方式。
- [机器人专用页](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/bot): 我们的扫描器抓取哪些端点、分值如何产生。
- [徽章](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/badge): 在你的网站上嵌入评级徽章。
- [API 文档](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/docs): 公开 API 参考、参数与示例 JSON 响应。
- [离线回退页](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/offline): 断网时显示的缓存目录视图。

## Categories (14, English)

- [Developer Tools](https://aiapp.im/c/dev-tools): SDKs, CLIs, and platforms for builders.
- [AI Applications & Assistants](https://aiapp.im/c/ai-tools): assistants, agents, and generative apps.
- [News & Media](https://aiapp.im/c/news): reporting and headlines from around the world.
- [E-commerce](https://aiapp.im/c/ecommerce): online stores and marketplaces.
- [Education](https://aiapp.im/c/education): courses, schools, and learning resources.
- [Finance](https://aiapp.im/c/finance): banking, markets, and financial data.
- [Social](https://aiapp.im/c/social): networks, communities, and messaging.
- [Entertainment](https://aiapp.im/c/entertainment): streaming, games, and culture.
- [Health](https://aiapp.im/c/health): health information and services.
- [Travel](https://aiapp.im/c/travel): booking, guides, and transport.
- [Government](https://aiapp.im/c/government): public sector and civic services.
- [Reference](https://aiapp.im/c/reference): encyclopedias, docs, and knowledge bases.
- [Developer documentation](https://aiapp.im/c/docs): documentation portals and API references.
- [Other](https://aiapp.im/c/other): everything outside the named categories.

Category pages also exist under the /zh-CN/ prefix, e.g. [中文 · Developer Tools](https://aiapp.im/zh-CN/c/dev-tools).

## API — human-readable documentation

- [API documentation](https://aiapp.im/docs): every public endpoint, parameters, error shapes, and example JSON responses.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://aiapp.im/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of the API (mirror at /.well-known/openapi.yaml).
- [Machine-readable AFR standard](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/method): `{ "standard": "AFR", "version": "...", "layers": [...], "grades": [...] }`.

## API endpoints

- [GET /api/v1/sites](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/sites): paginated listing; query params `category`, `grade`, `q`, `sort` (`score` | `rank` | `new`), `page`. Response: `{ "items": [...], "page": 1, "per_page": 24, "total": 8, "sort": "score" }`.
- [GET /api/v1/sites/:domain](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/sites/github.com): one site with its latest scan and evidence rows. Response: `{ "site": {...}, "scan": {...}, "evidence": [...] }`.
- [GET /api/v1/sites/:domain/history](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/sites/github.com/history): all scans for a domain, newest first.
- [GET /api/v1/stats](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/stats): totals and distribution. Response: `{ "total": 8, "verified": 4, "pending": 0, "avg_score": 58, "grades": { "A": 1, "B": 2, "C": 2, "D": 2, "F": 1 } }`.
- [GET /api/v1/categories](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/categories): category tree with counts. Response: `{ "categories": [ { "slug": "dev-tools", "name_en": "Developer Tools", "name_zh": "开发者工具", "count": 3, "children": [] } ] }`.
- [GET /api/v1/leaderboard](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/leaderboard): top sites by pure AFR score descending; optional `category` and `limit` (≤50). Response: `{ "category": null, "items": [ { "rank": 1, "domain": "github.com", "grade": "A", "score": 91, "category": "dev-tools", "strategy_tag": "AI-Open" } ] }`.
- [GET /badge/:domain.svg](https://aiapp.im/badge/example.com.svg): rating badge image (`image/svg+xml`, cached 1 hour).
- [POST /api/v1/submissions](https://aiapp.im/api/v1/submissions): `{ "domain": "example.com", "note": "optional" }` → `201 { "ok": true, "id": 1, "domain": "example.com", "status": "queued" }`; limited to 5 per IP per day.

All JSON endpoints send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Errors are JSON, e.g. `{ "error": "not_found" }` (404) or `{ "error": "rate_limited" }` (429).

## Optional: agent usage policy

- [Agent instructions](https://aiapp.im/agents.md): identify yourself with a descriptive User-Agent, keep to about one request per second, honor robots.txt and any Crawl-delay, cache responses, and re-fetch only what changed.
- [AI crawler policy](https://aiapp.im/ai.txt): short machine-readable summary of what AiApp.im allows.
- [robots.txt](https://aiapp.im/robots.txt): explicit Allow rules for the 14 AI user-agent families (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended) plus the Sitemap declaration.
- Reuse: ratings, grades, and check names may be reused with attribution to AiApp.im and the site page URL; the AFR standard text is CC BY 4.0. To cite a rating, include the domain, score, grade, engine version, and scan timestamp, and link back to the site's page on AiApp.im.
